title: Sofie Makes Toxic Beautiful With Her Recent Single “We Dey”
htmlContent:
Sofie brings some of her best work to date to make for a jam that you will want to be a part of every second on the new song “We Dey.” The single "We Dey" wastes no time in getting you invested, with a high-energy production that is engaging and layered in creativity to make music you haven’t heard before. With a daring creative energy to the music, it stands out from her other releases.

Sofie is a Multi-talented LA-Based Ghanaian singer, songwriter, and producer. She has gained acclaim on the music scene for some time and is currently earning a huge fan following across various music platforms, especially with the release of her recent song “We Dey.”
